issues.name: Leaf rust
ipm_steps: Monitor leaves weekly and remove volunteer wheat.
Use resistant varieties and timely sowing.
Apply registered fungicide when disease reaches threshold.

issues.name: Powdery mildew
ipm_steps: Improve spacing and reduce canopy humidity.
Avoid excess nitrogen and maintain balanced nutrition.
Use registered fungicide at early disease onset.

prevention: Sow healthy seed and use resistant cultivars.
Avoid dense canopy and excess nitrogen.
Review weather-driven disease alerts before spraying.
